author: Bizzuh
body:
• Bizzuh
  • The reason i was banned was due to so called "spider and kill aura." I don't see how a spider has to due with a banning and i am sure i didnt have a kill aura as i was just clicking as fast and hard as i can when facing other players. I was also on Skype with a friend to which when i killed him, his reply was bullshit i am going to report you...which I replied with "OK i don't see how me winning means i am cheating"
  • Due to my friend doing /report i was banned with what seemed like a hacking ability. I just wanted to play some PVP minecraft with my friends which took it a little to seriously. Thank you in Advance.
